name: Potato of Life — Full Mapping Roadmap
purpose: Turn the question 'what can a potato be?' into a complete, evidence-disciplined research programme that can be expanded across biology, geometry, history, symbolism, mythology, philosophy and the wider world graph.
central_question: What properties and relationships belong to the potato itself, what properties have been assigned to potatoes by human cultures, and what new structures become visible when those two domains are mapped together?
method: Start with the object. Map observable properties. Map external historical meanings. Map Potatoism's own meanings. Connect them through typed relationships. Test geometry and scale. Record contradictions. Only then interpret recurring structures.

mapping_stack.question: What can a potato physically and biologically do?
What does each property connect to?
What shapes and transformations describe the Potato of Life?
What has a potato become symbolically?
Where do these motifs exist independently of Potatoism?
What does the Potato mean inside this project?
How does the mandorla function inside the Potato of Life?
Does the same grammar recur elsewhere?
Where does the potato sit in the actual world system?
How does the meaning change through time?
What can be tested rather than merely described?
What remains after evidence, history, symbolism and interpretation are separated?

mapping_rule: Every major property should have an owner, a type, a relationship, an epistemic class and—where it is empirical or historical—a source. A symbolic assignment may be preserved without a source when it is explicitly identified as project-defined.
completion_test: The potato has a canonical entity record.
Its observable properties are separately represented from symbolic properties.
Its relationships to Tree, Axis, Ladder, Door, Son and Father resolve to canonical IDs.
The vesica-piscis and mandorla are mathematically defined.
Jesus Door is explicitly marked as Potatoism/project mythology rather than empirical fact.
External chariot/angel/messenger/ladder/door motifs have independent research records.
The same property can be followed from object → symbol → person/concept → history → world system.
Contradictory evidence and failed analogies remain visible.
No layer is considered complete merely because its file exists.
